readFile.description: Asynchronously read the contents of a file.

parameters.name: file
parameters.description: The path of the file to read.

parameters.name: readEncoding
parameters.description: The encoding to use for reading (optional).

returns.description: A promise resolving to the decoded file content.

readTextFromFile.description: Asynchronously read the text contents of a file.

parameters.name: file
parameters.description: The path of the file to read.

parameters.name: readEncoding
parameters.description: The encoding to use for reading (optional).

returns.description: A promise resolving to the text content of the file.

write.description: Asynchronously write the parsed text to a file.

parameters.name: file
parameters.description: The path of the file to write.

parameters.name: encoding
parameters.description: The encoding to use for writing (optional).

parameters.name: bom
parameters.description: Whether to include a byte order mark (optional).

returns.description: A promise indicating the success of the write operation.

.detectEncoding.description: Detect the encoding of the given buffer.

parameters.name: buffer
parameters.description: The buffer to detect encoding from.
